walls.note: South-east front: nine-bay arcade, striped wall behind, cupola row, upper hall, minaret at the east corner (recording_2025-07-31 00010..00017, TMX 002554 000901, 002378 0007 000074).

items.where: two-storey-high arcade along the whole front: nine bays of white columns with capitals, thick white arch rings with keystones, brick spandrels, a projecting white cornice at 8.9 m
items.how: builder: cylinders, capital blocks, extruded arch rings and spandrels, keystone boxes, cornice box (arcade(), 3.07 m pitch)

items.where: striped brick wall behind the columns: dark brown bands alternating with ochre bands to 5.7 m, plain red brick above
items.how: builder: dark base with ochre band boxes 4.5 cm proud every 0.9 m and a red brick course above

items.where: tall white-framed rectangular windows with mullions and transoms, small round-arched windows above, per bay
items.how: builder: win(): white surround ring, glass, mullion and two transoms; arched variant

items.where: row of small lead cupolas on cornice blocks with gilt crescents above the arcade cornice, one per bay
items.how: builder: cupola(): brick drum, two white cornice steps, lead dome, gilt pole and crescent

items.where: brick minaret at the east corner on a round turret, white band, two balconies with balustrades, lead spire
items.how: builder: turret and tapering shaft cylinders, balcony discs with posts and rails, spire

walls.note: North-east front along the street: eleven-bay arcade, cupola row, upper hall with dentil cornice and round-arched windows (TMX 002378 pano 0007 000070/72, 0008 000220).

items.where: the same arcade continues along the north-east front: eleven bays
items.how: builder: arcade() on the north-east face

items.where: upper hall: red brick walls, round-arched windows with white surrounds and oculi, white dentil cornice at 17.2-17.8 m
items.how: builder: chamfered prism, win() arched, dentil boxes, cornice slab

items.where: shallow lead dome over the hall with a gilt finial (hidden from the street by the cupolas; apex from 3DBAG)
items.how: builder: ellipsoid dome with gilt pole and crescent; no ribs or lantern are visible in the panoramas

walls.note: North-west annex front: no panorama sees it; arcade-height cornice and plain windows inferred from the 3DBAG wall heights (6.5-8.7 m).
South-west front: not photographed; plain striped wall and windows inferred from 3DBAG.
